strategy: Keep this product database as the URL seed and avoid retailer search pages during normal updates.
Refresh category listing pages slowly only as a discovery guardrail, then update each product by its direct product URL.
Use per-retailer throttling, retries with backoff, and preserve previous rows if a product page redirects, times out, or temporarily omits price data.
Write a dated snapshot first, validate counts/category totals, then publish/update pages only if validation passes.
